channel.title: Wisconsin Newspaper Association - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Wisconsin Newspaper Association (wnanews.com)

item.title: New limits on student cellphones in Wisconsin schools
item.description: Starting July 1, 2026, every Wisconsin public school district must limit student use of personal cellphones and other wireless devices during instructional time. Let's review what parents should know.

item.title: Sunshine Week 2026 toolkit available online
item.description: Sunshine Week, set for March 15-21, 2026, is a nonpartisan collaboration among groups in the journalism, civic, education, government and private sectors that shines a light on the importance of public records and open government.

item.title: UW’s request for NIL help, more facilities dollars includes Public Records Law exemption
item.description: The University of Wisconsin athletic department traditionally has been self-supporting financially, but that could change under a state legislative bill that also seeks an exemption from the Wisconsin Public Records Law.

item.title: Sunshine Week: Support local journalism
item.description: Sunshine Week is March 15-21, and this year, there’s an even greater need for you to get involved.

item.title: News/Media Alliance applauds Supreme Court decision overruling IEPPA tariffs
item.description: The News/Media Alliance applauded the Supreme Court of the United States for its Feb. 20, 2026 decision declaring the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEPPA) tariffs as unlawful.

item.title: Bipartisan call for WisEye bids clears Wisconsin Senate
item.description: A bipartisan measure seeking to open a competitive bidding process to solicit bids for a statewide public affairs network — a service that’s been provided by WisconsinEye for the last 18 years — while also providing temporary funds to keep WisconsinEye’s cameras running in the meantime cleared the state Senate Wednesday, Feb. 18.

item.title: UPDATE: CFINR award entry deadline extended to February 20
item.description: Now in its third year, the Center for Integrity in News Reporting Awards will present six $25,000 cash prizes, including a new category for Investigative Reporting, alongside awards for Print, Broadcast, Cable Network, Digital Reporting, and reporting by members of the White House Correspondents’ Association.

item.title: Millions in taxpayer funds for UW approved in bill that also seeks state public records law exemption
item.description: A fast-tracked bill that would provide millions in taxpayer support for University of Wisconsin Athletics and cement the university’s name, image and likeness policies into state law passed the Assembly on Thursday, Feb. 19.

item.title: UW to host ‘Democracy in the Balance: The Essential Role of Journalism in Advancing Civil Discourse’
item.description: Join journalist and media executive Andy Lack and UW-Madison School of Journalism and Mass Communications Director Kathleen Bartzen Culver for a timely conversation on journalism’s essential role in sustaining democracy from 5-7 p.m. on Thursday, March 5 at the Pyle Center on the UW-Madison campus.

item.title: NNA reacts to SCOTUS tariff ruling that federal government exceeded authority
item.description: The National Newspaper Association (NNA) on Feb. 20, 2026 expressed strong approval of the U.S. Supreme Court’s ruling that the federal government exceeded its authority under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) by imposing sweeping tariffs without clear Congressional authorization.
